title: garnotia thwaitesii
intro: Garnotia thwaitesii, commonly known as the 'Sri Lankan wild jasmine', is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities that may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Garnotia thwaitesii include its ability to act as an anti-oxidant and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Garnotia thwaitesii include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have potential in the development of new pharmaceuticals.
